verdict.rationale: Glama ships a built-in chat assistant (glama.ai/chat). It gives access to leading models, answers questions over uploaded documents with page references, and turns text into diagrams. The pricing page also mentions automating workflows via schedules or webhooks. This is mostly conversational help, though; nothing shows the assistant acting on tasks inside the product, such as using MCP servers or managing deployments. Missing for 10: evidence that the chat assistant executes multi-step tasks or tool calls, evidence that it is connected to Glama's MCP/gateway features, clarity on whether the workflow automation is AI-driven, independent or hands-on corroboration.
